title: 贝莱德Rieder：前端收益率曲线仍具吸引力
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Rick Reed with BlackRock writing, being patient on interest rate exposure makes sense, but dipping a toe on these historically attractive real rates
segments.zh: 贝莱德的Rieder写道，对利率敞口保持耐心是合理的，但在这历史性有吸引力的实际利率上小试一把

segments.en: makes sense to us. Rick joins us now for more. Rick, good to see you, buddy.
segments.zh: 对我们来说合理。Rick现在加入我们。Rick，很高兴见到你，伙计。

segments.en: Every time I see you, you seem happy at the bond market's fall into pieces.
segments.zh: 每次见到你，债券市场波动时你似乎都很开心。

segments.en: Just explain why. Why'd you like this? So, by the way, I'm doing this from Saskatchewan, which is a good, cool place to be.
segments.zh: 解释一下为什么。你为什么喜欢这样？顺便说，我是从萨斯喀彻温省做的，这是个不错、凉爽的地方。

segments.en: So, I know it. Thank you guys for having me. The, um, so listen, I mean, this is, I mean, this is historic and I've waited decades for these real rates
segments.zh: 我知道。谢谢你们邀请我。听着，这是历史性的，我等了几十年才等到这样的实际利率

segments.en: and to be able to create income at these level. Your levels, your buying fixed income assets with the risk free rate really high.
segments.zh: 能够在这种水平创造收益。你的水平，你购买固定收益资产时无风险利率非常高。

segments.en: And so, listen, we manage our interest rate exposure.
segments.zh: 所以，听着，我们管理我们的利率敞口。

segments.en: Like, I don't feel like the back end of the yield curve today is given us such a great opportunity.
segments.zh: 我觉得今天收益率曲线的长端并没有给我们这么好的机会。

segments.en: But the front end of the curve to keep your volatility down, keep your income high is still very attractive today.
segments.zh: 但曲线前端，保持低波动、高收益，今天仍然非常有吸引力。

segments.en: So, listen, I think, you know, part of it, you know, our funds are actually doing okay.
segments.zh: 所以，听着，我认为，你知道，部分原因是，我们的基金实际上表现还不错。

segments.en: You know, we're up money in a year. The fixed income is down. You got to manage your interest rate exposure.
segments.zh: 过去一年我们是赚钱的，固收在跌，你得管理好利率敞口。

segments.en: You got to keep your back end interest rate risk flow.
segments.zh: 你得控制长端利率风险。

segments.en: But the income is incredible. They carry you yet from buying these assets.
segments.zh: 但收益非常可观，买这些资产能带来持有回报。

segments.en: I mean, you could buy high yield at eight and a half percent. Two thirds of that yield is coming from the risk free rate.
segments.zh: 你可以买到8.5%的高收益债，其中三分之二的收益来自无风险利率。

segments.en: We had nine years of negative interest rates in Europe, as you remember.
segments.zh: 大家记得，欧洲曾经历九年负利率。

segments.en: Like, these are pretty good levels. Again, I'm not saying let's jump in and buy the back end of the yield curve.
segments.zh: 这些水平相当不错。我不是说现在就冲进去买长端。

segments.en: Let's jump in and buy long-term interest rates.
segments.zh: 也不是说现在就冲进去买长期利率。
